Final or Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 11351-11355 South Aberdeen Avenue, Chicago,
IL

Proposed Zoning: | RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 6,250.5 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with two (2) new
three-story residential buildings. Each building will contain two (2)
dwelling units. The proposed buildings will measure 27 ft. in height and
will each be supported by two (2) off-street parking spaces. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D
optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
increase the off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location
from 50% (one (1) parking space) to 100% (two (2) parking spaces) for
11355 South Aberdeen Avenue, increase the off-street parking requirement
from 50% (one (1) parking space) to 100% (two (2) parking spaces) for
11351 South Aberdeen Avenue, and is seeking all relief necessary, as
allowed by the code, for the attached plans.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio:
a. 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue: 2,511 square feet (0.8 FAR)
b. 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue: 2,511 square feet (0.8 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.):
a. 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue: 1,562.63 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)
b. 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue: 1,562.63 square feet per D.U.
(2 residential units)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking:
a. 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue: 2 parking spaces
b. 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue: 2 parking spaces

*The Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking requirement for a
Transit Served Location from 50% (one (1) parking space) 100% (two (2) parking
spaces) for 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue, and increase the off-street parking
requirement from 50% (one (1) parking space) to 100% (two (2) parking spaces)
for 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue.

(D) _ Setbacks:
a. 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue:
i. Front Setback: 15 feet
ii. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 2.5 feet
South Side: 3 feet

Final for Publication

iii, Rear Setback: 45.01 feet

b. 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue:
i. Front Setback: 15 feet
ii. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 2.5 feet
South Side: 3 feet
ii, Rear Setback: 45.01

(©) Building Height:
a. 11351 South Aberdeen Avenue: 27 feet
b. 11355 South Aberdeen Avenue: 27 feet
